source: Quiz 5 - Sessions 1-6: Model Training, Alignment, and the Agent Harness
question: How can two models follow the same broad computation pattern yet differ greatly?

options.text: The processing pattern determines the same learned values
options.feedback: The program specifies operations. Training can produce different values even when the broad computation pattern is similar.

options.text: The processing pattern lists each model's possible answers
options.feedback: A broad algorithm is not a catalogue of responses. Learned values and context also affect the model's behavior.

options.text: The processing pattern gives a complete account of capability
options.feedback: Knowing the operations does not specify the parameter arrays or explain every learned behavior. Similar steps can underlie very different models.

options.text: The parameter arrays differ in size or learned values
options.feedback: The same broad operations can use different collections of learned numbers. Knowing the processing pattern does not specify the full model.
